tools.description: Fetch a random cat fact from a public API. Optionally cap its character length.

maxLength.description: Maximum character length of the returned fact.

tools.name: template_cat_fact

tools.description: Echo a message back with optional formatting and repetition.

mode.description: How to format the message before repetition. `standard` returns it unchanged.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the formatted message.

includeTimestamp.description: Whether to include an ISO 8601 timestamp in the response.

tools.name: template_echo_message

tools.description: Fetch a random cat image and return it base64-encoded with its MIME type.

trigger.description: Set true to fetch a new image. Exists because some clients require a non-empty input schema.

tools.name: template_image_test

tools.description: Combine a noun, verb, and adjective into a one-line Mad Libs story. Any parts of speech omitted from the input are requested from the user during execution.

verb.description: A verb (past tense) for the story.

tools.name: template_madlibs_elicitation

tools.description: Run a countdown timer for the requested number of seconds, reporting progress as it ticks. Cancellable mid-run. On task-capable clients the call returns immediately and progress streams over the task channel; otherwise it runs synchronously and returns when the countdown finishes.

seconds.description: Number of seconds to count down (1-60)

message.description: Optional message to include in the final result

inputSchema.description: Parameters for the async countdown task.

tools.name: template_async_countdown

tools.description: Generate sample sales data and render an interactive table. Users can sort columns, filter rows, and select entries from the UI. Falls back to a plain text table where interactive UI is not available.

rowCount.description: Number of sample rows to generate (5-100).

tools.name: template_data_explorer
